title: Financial Procedures
description: Quiz on public financial management, budgeting, and audit processes.

questions.question: Primary purpose of a national budget?
questions.explanation: Budgets align resources with policy priorities.

questions.question: True or False: External audit strengthens accountability.
questions.explanation: Independent audits detect misuse and recommend improvements.

questions.question: Select core stages of the budget cycle.
questions.explanation: Cycles include formulation, execution, oversight; secrecy undermines transparency.

questions.question: Which mechanism curbs overspending mid-year?
questions.explanation: Supplementary controls adjust and authorize changes.

questions.question: Medium-term expenditure frameworks help by:
questions.explanation: They link policy to multi-year resource envelopes.

questions.question: Performance budgeting emphasizes:
questions.explanation: Performance systems focus on results, not just inputs.
